import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

# Using the same architecture definition as the previous failed attempt
class BottleneckBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    dilation: int
    ratio: float = 0.25
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray) -> jnp.ndarray:
        y = nn.Conv(features=int(self.features * self.ratio), kernel_size=(1, 1))(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(features=int(self.features * self.ratio), kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation))(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(1, 1))(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class GradientProbeSotaNet(nn.Module):
    conv_lstm_features: int
    dilation: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, Dict]:
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        spatial_features, time_feature_map = x[..., :7], x[..., 7]
        time_scalar = time_feature_map[:, 0, 0].reshape(-1, 1)
        y = nn.Conv(features=32, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', name="CNN_Block_1")(spatial_features)
        y = BottleneckBlock(features=32, dilation=self.dilation, name="CNN_Block_2")(y)
        y = BottleneckBlock(features=32, dilation=self.dilation, name="CNN_Block_3")(y)
        y = nn.Conv(features=64, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', name="CNN_Block_4")(y)
        y = BottleneckBlock(features=64, dilation=self.dilation, name="CNN_Block_5")(y)
        cnn_out = BottleneckBlock(features=64, dilation=self.dilation, name="CNN_Final_Block")(y)
        conv_lstm_cell = nn.ConvLSTMCell(features=self.conv_lstm_features, kernel_size=(3, 3), name="recurrent_core")
        if rnn_state is None:
            h, w = cnn_out.shape[1], cnn_out.shape[2]
            dummy_c, dummy_h = jnp.zeros((batch_size, h, w, self.conv_lstm_features)), jnp.zeros((batch_size, h, w, self.conv_lstm_features))
            rnn_state = (dummy_c, dummy_h)
        done_mask_spatial = done.reshape(batch_size, 1, 1, 1)
        rnn_state = jax.tree.map(lambda val: val * (1 - done_mask_spatial), rnn_state)
        rnn_state, y = conv_lstm_cell(rnn_state, cnn_out)
        rnn_state, y = conv_lstm_cell(rnn_state, cnn_out)
        h, w, c = y.shape[1], y.shape[2], y.shape[3]
        y_flat = y.reshape(batch_size, h * w, c)
        attn_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_logits")(y_flat).squeeze(-1)
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=-1)
        attn_pooled = jnp.sum(y_flat * attn_weights[..., None], axis=1)
        gap_pooled = jnp.mean(y_flat, axis=1)
        pooled_features = jnp.concatenate([attn_pooled, gap_pooled], axis=-1)
        final_features = jnp.concatenate([pooled_features, time_scalar], axis=-1)
        x_head = nn.Dense(features=256, name="shared_head")(final_features)
        x_head = nn.relu(x_head)
        policy_logits, value = nn.Dense(features=4, name="policy_head")(x_head), nn.Dense(features=1, name="value_head")(x_head).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def test():
    rng = jax.random.PRNGKey(42)
    dummy_obs, dummy_done = jnp.zeros((32, 8, 8, 8)), jnp.zeros((32,), dtype=jnp.bool_)
    fixed_input = jax.random.normal(rng, (32, 8, 8, 8))
    
    model = GradientProbeSotaNet(dilation=7, conv_lstm_features=64)
    params = model.init(rng, dummy_obs, dummy_done, None)['params']
    
    def loss_fn(p):
        _, value, _ = model.apply({'params': p}, fixed_input, dummy_done, None)
        return jnp.mean(value)
    
    grads = jax.grad(loss_fn)(params)
    
    # The sole purpose of this run is to get the structure.
    print("--- Gradient PyTree Structure ---")
    # Use jax.tree_util.tree_map to print shapes, which is more concise than printing raw arrays.
    grad_shapes = jax.tree_util.tree_map(lambda x: x.shape, grads)
    print(grad_shapes)
    print("---------------------------------")
    
    return "PyTree structure printed to STDOUT. Check logs for the exact parameter paths."
